name: David Thompson
bioAdditions: Eldest son of Jonathan Thompson (S1): 4th cousin 7 times removed via John Thompson, 5th cousin 6 times removed via Bull Smith. Married Sarah Diodati Gardiner; children Sarah G. (Mrs Col. David Lion Gardiner), Elizabeth, Gardiner, David Gardiner, Charles Griswold, Mary Gardiner and Frederick Diodati (proprietor of Sagtikos Manor in 1898).

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 470
